source_units.text: Compose the citation on a fictional achievement certificate.
Keep the complete piece to 50–80 words.
Include the following invented details: The fictional certificate recognizes patient experimentation in developing the paper turbine.
Praise turning questions into trials and recording failed versions as carefully as successful ones; do not claim an external prize.
Preserve these exact phrases: "patient experimentation", "the paper turbine", "turning questions into trials".
